entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso (R)
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso (R): ""I can't tell you how much I've bee..."
entries.dialogueText: "I can't tell you how much I've been looking forward to today. It's an occasion to celebrate the multi-faceted economic partnership we are building between our great nations."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso (R)
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso (R): ""It stands as a symbol of the aspir..."
entries.dialogueText: "It stands as a symbol of the aspirations of the Sordish people. Including my own aspirations to further the economic partnership we've begun to build between our two great nations."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso (R)
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso (R): ""It stands as a symbol of the aspir..."
entries.dialogueText: "It stands as a symbol of the aspirations of the Sordish people. Including my own aspirations to achieve a win-win deal between our great nations."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Upon entering the grand lobby of Ho..."
entries.dialogueText: Upon entering the grand lobby of Holsord Tower, we were directed towards a lavish elevator.

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso (R)
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso (R): ""Holsord's modernity represents our..."
entries.dialogueText: "Holsord's modernity represents our drive towards progress, much like our efforts in modernizing Sordland's key industries."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The cabin slowly ascended, giving u..."
entries.dialogueText: The cabin slowly ascended, giving us a momentary sense of detachment from the world below. The cityscape of Holsord became a moving panorama through the glass walls.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""We're certainly not in Porte Drazo..."
entries.dialogueText: "We're certainly not in Porte Drazon anymore."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso (R)
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso (R): ""Quite the sight, isn't it? It's al..."
entries.dialogueText: "Quite the sight, isn't it? It's always interesting to see Holsord from this perspective. I hope your first impression of our city is a favorable one."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I'll admit I'm impressed. But I've..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'll admit I'm impressed. But I've always believed that the true character of a city is found not in its skyline but in the lives of its people."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "A server came around and poured us..."
entries.dialogueText: A server came around and poured us glasses of a cloudy-looking liquid that I recognized as kebij. It was time for me to make the opening remarks for the bond deal discussion.

entries.speaker: Gus Manger (R)
entries.title: Gus Manger (R): ""Right on. It's the everyday folks..."
entries.dialogueText: "Right on. It's the everyday folks that really tell you what a place is about, recession or not."

entries.speaker: Gus Manger (R)
entries.title: Gus Manger (R): ""You can't just cling to the past i..."
entries.dialogueText: "You can't just cling to the past if you want to move forward. But then, forgetting where you came from isn't the answer either."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""The true test of a city is how it..."
entries.dialogueText: "The true test of a city is how it supports its most vulnerable. Especially during times of economic instability, wouldn't you say, Mr. President?"

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""We understand completely. Rizia is..."
entries.dialogueText: "We understand completely. Rizia is in the process of evolving right now, while holding on to what makes us unique as a nation."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I'm much more interested in seeing..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm much more interested in seeing the Maroon Palace later. Concrete needles don't impress me as much as history and culture."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso (R)
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso (R): ""I should have expected you'd be a..."
entries.dialogueText: "I should have expected you'd be a history buff. The Maroon Palace does hold stories that no modern edifice can."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso (R)
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso (R): ""Direct and to the point – a qualit..."
entries.dialogueText: "Direct and to the point – a quality I admire. Time is indeed a luxury we don't have in abundance."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso (R)
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso (R): ""We'll continue this conversation o..."
entries.dialogueText: "We'll continue this conversation over dinner. The views from the revolving restaurant are nothing less than astounding."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso (R)
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso (R): ""You said it, Your Majesty.""
entries.dialogueText: "You said it, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso (R)
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso (R): ""A solid start.""
entries.dialogueText: "A solid start."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso (R)
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso (R): ""As the tower defies the limits of..."
entries.dialogueText: "As the tower defies the limits of architecture, so too can our nations push the limits of partnership."

entries.dialogueText: "Shall we?"

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso (R)

entries.dialogueText: He nodded.

entries.title: Narrator: "A silence settled between the deleg..."
entries.dialogueText: A silence settled between the delegations.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "We shook hands and I nodded."
entries.dialogueText: We shook hands and I nodded.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You know, this could be good train..."
entries.dialogueText: "You know, this could be good training for your upcoming elections against Anton Rayne. A nod-off, perhaps?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I nodded again."
entries.dialogueText: I nodded again.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Is this a Sordish tradition, Presi..."
entries.dialogueText: "Is this a Sordish tradition, President Alphonso?"

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso (R)
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso (R): ""Why do you think Sordish necks are..."
entries.dialogueText: "Why do you think Sordish necks are this thick? All the diplomatic nodding we do."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I'm beginning to think I should al..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm beginning to think I should allocate a separate budget for neck massages."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Maybe we should start a new trend..."
entries.dialogueText: "Maybe we should start a new trend – diplomatic winks instead. It’s less strenuous and twice as mysterious!"

entries.dialogueText: "Princess Vina, it's an honor to welcome you. Mr. Manger and our team will ensure all your needs are met during your stay."

entries.dialogueText: "Thank you, President Alphonso. I've studied much about Sordland's recent history and can't wait to experience its culture first-hand."

entries.title: Ewald Alphonso (R): ""I suspect this is an unspoken cont..."
entries.dialogueText: "I suspect this is an unspoken contest of diplomatic resilience. Let's call it a draw for now and save our strength for the discussions ahead."

entries.title: Ewald Alphonso (R): ""At this rate, we'll need to train..."
entries.dialogueText: "At this rate, we'll need to train our diplomats not just in etiquette, but in endurance. Perhaps Sordland can lead the way in nodding diplomacy."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Why, thank you. It's comforting to..."
entries.dialogueText: "Why, thank you. It's comforting to know Princess Vina will be in good hands."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You'll be the one begging for assi..."
entries.dialogueText: "You'll be the one begging for assistance after a few hours of my daughter asking questions."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Splendid. And if today's meeting g..."
entries.dialogueText: "Splendid. And if today's meeting goes like our last did, I assume a taste of Sordland's finest beverages is in order."

entries.speaker: Gus Manger (R)
entries.title: Gus Manger (R): ""If Your Majesty desires, so it wil..."
entries.dialogueText: "If Your Majesty desires, so it will be. Although you've already made it abundantly clear what you think of our whiskey--"

entries.speaker: Gus Manger (R)
entries.title: Gus Manger (R): ""Ha. Ask away, Your Highness! You'r..."
entries.dialogueText: "Ha. Ask away, Your Highness! You're talking to an expert."

entries.speaker: Gus Manger (R)
entries.title: Gus Manger (R): ""No worries, Your Majesty. We'll ma..."
entries.dialogueText: "No worries, Your Majesty. We'll make sure your entire delegation gets the full Sordish experience – top-notch and no fuss."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""We appreciate it, Mr. Manger. It's..."
entries.dialogueText: "We appreciate it, Mr. Manger. It's important for us to see Sordland the way it truly is, beyond the official veneer."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""Just don't tire them out too much,..."
entries.dialogueText: "Just don't tire them out too much, Vina. We still need them focused for our meetings."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""Yes, please don't feel the need to..."
entries.dialogueText: "Yes, please don't feel the need to put on a show on my behalf."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""Don't worry. There are a great man..."
entries.dialogueText: "Don't worry. There are a great many things I'm curious about, though."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso (R)
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso (R): ""If it's beverages you want, we'll..."
entries.dialogueText: "If it's beverages you want, we'll introduce you to kebij. I warn you that it's a bit... rustic, but it has its own special charms."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Just wait until you try Sordish za..."
entries.dialogueText: "Just wait until you try Sordish zabla, Vina. It's the best."

entries.speaker: Gus Manger (R)
entries.title: Gus Manger (R): ""You know our cuisine well, Your Ma..."
entries.dialogueText: "You know our cuisine well, Your Majesty! Yes, nothing beats zabla with a cold glass of kebij... or Erlory Maroon."

entries.speaker: Gus Manger (R)
entries.title: Gus Manger (R): ""But you've already made it clear w..."
entries.dialogueText: "But you've already made it clear what Rizia thinks of our fine whiskey, haven't you?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Alphonso shot him a warning look. H..."
entries.dialogueText: Alphonso shot him a warning look. He shut his mouth.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""As long as you avoid any overly ro..."
entries.dialogueText: "As long as you avoid any overly rowdy or scandalous activities that might not befit her status as a princess."

entries.speaker: Gus Manger (R)
entries.title: Gus Manger (R): ""Understood, Your Majesty. We'll ma..."
entries.dialogueText: "Understood, Your Majesty. We'll make sure all events are up to royal standards – sophisticated, respectful, absolutely dripping with taste."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""We Rizians cut loose every now and..."
entries.dialogueText: "We Rizians cut loose every now and again too, you know. But we do wish to refrain from making too much of a stir abroad."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""I can handle a little rowdiness, F..."
entries.dialogueText: "I can handle a little rowdiness, Father. I find it charming in its own way."

entries.dialogueText: "Ahem. Glad as I am to see you both in agreement, shall we move on to more pressing matters?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He nodded back again and shook my h..."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic

entries.dialogueText: I gestured to Laurento to take the lead.

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso (R)
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso (R): ""Are we setting a new standard for..."
entries.dialogueText: "Are we setting a new standard for international greetings?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Only if the next standard involves..."
entries.dialogueText: "Only if the next standard involves a friendly arm-wrestling match, President Alphonso. It could be the ultimate test of diplomatic strength!"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Perhaps but I'm holding out for th..."
entries.dialogueText: "Perhaps but I'm holding out for the day when we switch to high-fives. It’s the future of international relations!"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I was thinking more along the line..."
entries.dialogueText: "I was thinking more along the lines of a staring contest. First one to blink handles the next trade negotiation!"

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso (R)
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso (R): ""An arm-wrestling match? Now that w..."
entries.dialogueText: "An arm-wrestling match? Now that would be a sight at the next AN summit. I’ll start training right away to beat Chairman Hegel!"

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso (R)
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso (R): ""High-fives could indeed add some f..."
entries.dialogueText: "High-fives could indeed add some flair to our meetings."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso (R)
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso (R): ""Well, King Romus, this must be a r..."
entries.dialogueText: "Well, King Romus, this must be a record for the longest handshake in diplomatic history!"

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""As much as I'd enjoy seeing these..."
entries.dialogueText: "As much as I'd enjoy seeing these new diplomatic practices, perhaps we should reserve our strength for the negotiations ahead."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "President Ewald Alphonso's gaze bri..."
entries.dialogueText: President Ewald Alphonso's gaze briefly swept across our group before settling on Princess Vina.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Oh, it is. A perfect blend of hist..."
entries.dialogueText: "Oh, it is. A perfect blend of history and modernity, just as we're striving to achieve in Rizia."

entries.speaker: Gus Manger (R)
entries.title: Gus Manger (R): ""Yeah, it's something. But remember..."
entries.dialogueText: "Yeah, it's something. But remember, we used to be a kingdom too. Beneath all this modernity, we've still got our historical roots."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""One does wonder how your country's..."
entries.dialogueText: "One does wonder how your country's recession has affected the lives behind these modern facades."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso (R)
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso (R): ""I promise you that once the market..."
entries.dialogueText: "I promise you that once the market readjusts itself, Holsord's citizens will reap the fruits of our privatization initiatives. The streets will come alive once more."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso (R)
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso (R): ""Unlike a certain Colonel Soll, I a..."
entries.dialogueText: "Unlike a certain Colonel Soll, I and my administration have no intention of erasing Sordland's history."

entries.dialogueText: From the cobbled streets of the Old Town to the skyscrapers of the Maroon District, the greenery of the Capitol Park to the diversity of New Erlory – the city was a seamless blend of past and present.

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso (R)
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso (R): ""It's a lot like your Old Town in P..."
entries.dialogueText: "It's a lot like your Old Town in Porte Drazon, just... newer. The city was founded on the east side of the Eskel River in the early 1400s. It started as a key rest and recovery stop for traders, growing significantly during the Renan period."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso (R)
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso (R): ""Its architecture, from the Renan d..."
entries.dialogueText: "Its architecture, from the Renan days to the Sordish-Agnolian union-state era, is a mirror of Sordland's history."

entries.speaker: Gus Manger (R)
entries.title: Gus Manger (R): ""That's right. The Old Town's got t..."
entries.dialogueText: "That's right. The Old Town's got this timeless aura, you know? The tourists can't get enough of it."

entries.speaker: Gus Manger (R)
entries.title: Gus Manger (R): ""It's got all the fancy buildings,..."
entries.dialogueText: "It's got all the fancy buildings, businesses, embassies... everything a modern metropolis could need."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso (R)
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso (R): ""Its blend of modernist and neo-cla..."
entries.dialogueText: "Its blend of modernist and neo-classical architecture reflected the aspirations Soll held for a progressive Sordland. At the time."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso (R)
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso (R): ""That's what our late President Wis..."
entries.dialogueText: "That's what our late President Wisci intended. His initial conception for the district was taken over by President Tarquin Soll after the Civil War. It was renamed to symbolize the rebirth of Holsord under the Second Republic."

entries.speaker: Gus Manger (R)
entries.title: Gus Manger (R): ""The park's a favorite spot for fol..."
entries.dialogueText: "The park's a favorite spot for folks around here. Great place to relax and get away from the city rush."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso (R)
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso (R): ""And the government buildings, incl..."
entries.dialogueText: "And the government buildings, including the Maroon Palace and the Grand National Assembly, are not just architectural marvels but also the epicenters of our nation's governance."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso (R)
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso (R): ""These buildings represent our demo..."
entries.dialogueText: "These buildings represent our democratic journey, especially the Assembly where elected representatives work for Sordland's future."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso (R)
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso (R): ""Yes, it's there every week. Part o..."
entries.dialogueText: "Yes, it's there every week. Part of the district's melting-pot charm."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso (R)
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso (R): ""Ever since migrants from Erlory st..."
entries.dialogueText: "Ever since migrants from Erlory started settling there a century ago, it's attracted all kinds of diverse inhabitants. I'd call it Holsord's most vibrant neighborhood."

entries.speaker: Gus Manger (R)
entries.title: Gus Manger (R): ""Not to mention that the nightlife..."
entries.dialogueText: "Not to mention that the nightlife can't be beat. Remind me to take you to Cabaret Lachaven if we have time after dinner."

entries.title: Ewald Alphonso (R): ""All progress comes with some sacri..."
entries.dialogueText: "All progress comes with some sacrifice. Our people will be better off in the long-term."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso (R)
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso (R): ""But the recession of '51 was a dir..."
entries.dialogueText: "But the recession of '51 was a direct result of the entrenched systemic issues we inherited. Thanks to the aggressive economic reforms I'm putting into place, our growth will only skyrocket from here."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso (R)
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso (R): ""It may be a controversial move, bu..."
entries.dialogueText: "It may be a controversial move, but privatizing key sectors -- and, crucially, attracting foreign investment -- will position Sordland towards a globally competitive, prosperous and stable future in the 60s."

entries.speaker: Gus Manger (R)
entries.title: Gus Manger (R): ""I'm almost jealous. It's been a re..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm almost jealous. It's been a real pain trying to explain economic growth to our more thick-headed Assembly members."

entries.speaker: Gus Manger (R)
entries.title: Gus Manger (R): ""Just imagine, Ewald. If Sordland w..."
entries.dialogueText: "Just imagine, Ewald. If Sordland were a monarchy again, we'd be able to push these reforms in the blink of an eye."

entries.speaker: Gus Manger (R)
entries.title: Gus Manger (R): ""As someone who's worked in rural a..."
entries.dialogueText: "As someone who's worked in rural areas and seen the reality, let me tell you – investment and growth often lift all boats."

entries.speaker: Gus Manger (R)
entries.title: Gus Manger (R): ""Sure, we need to tackle the wealth..."
entries.dialogueText: "Sure, we need to tackle the wealth gap. But it's not just about handouts; it's about creating real, sustainable opportunities."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I appreciate what you've done for..."
entries.dialogueText: "I appreciate what you've done for your country. But in Rizia, we prefer gradual changes. Tradition must always be respected."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Such aggressive reforms may work i..."
entries.dialogueText: "Such aggressive reforms may work in Sordland. But in Rizia, sudden changes have the potential to unsettle the populace to a dangerous degree."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I see the merit in your approach...."
entries.dialogueText: "I see the merit in your approach. Rizia itself could benefit from the kind of liberal economic changes you're implementing here."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I'm completely on board with your..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm completely on board with your approach. Rizia itself is undergoing a series of privatization measures."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The staff guided us towards a large..."
entries.dialogueText: The staff guided us towards a large table. The gentle hum of conversation enveloped us as we were seated.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Alphonso laughed uncomfortably."
entries.dialogueText: Alphonso laughed uncomfortably.

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso (R)
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso (R): ""So I've heard! It's encouraging to..."
entries.dialogueText: "So I've heard! It's encouraging to know that beneath those kingly robes beats the heart of a fellow fiscal liberal."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso (R)
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso (R): ""It's encouraging to hear that you..."
entries.dialogueText: "It's encouraging to hear that you see the potential in liberal reforms, Your Majesty. Just as I acknowledge the benefits of Rizia's adherence to tradition."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso (R)
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso (R): ""Undoubtedly, the pace of reform mu..."
entries.dialogueText: "Undoubtedly, the pace of reform must match society's readiness for change."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso (R)
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso (R): ""Rapid reforms do come with risks...."
entries.dialogueText: "Rapid reforms do come with risks. However, we in Sordland reached a point where the risk of inaction outweighed the risk of change."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""We do cherish our monarchy in Rizi..."
entries.dialogueText: "We do cherish our monarchy in Rizia. But we're also open to learning from the reform experiences of nations like Sordland."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You're overestimating how easy it..."
entries.dialogueText: "You're overestimating how easy it is to pass reforms in Rizia. The public doesn't react well to sudden changes of any kind."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Our methods may differ. But in the..."
entries.dialogueText: "Our methods may differ. But in the end, both of us share the common goal of bettering our citizens' lives."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I daresay you'd look good with a c..."
entries.dialogueText: "I daresay you'd look good with a crown on your head, Mr. President."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso (R)
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso (R): ""Ehm. Thank you.""
entries.dialogueText: "Ehm. Thank you."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso (R)
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso (R): ""Great to know, Your Majesty. It so..."
entries.dialogueText: "Great to know, Your Majesty. It sounds like our countries still have much to learn from each other."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso (R)
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso (R): ""So. Here we are.""
entries.dialogueText: "So. Here we are."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso (R)
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso (R): ""Any questions about this magnifice..."
entries.dialogueText: "Any questions about this magnificent panorama, Your Majesty? I'm happy to offer my insights into the various districts of our fair city."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The elevator gently halted at the t..."
entries.dialogueText: The elevator gently halted at the top of Holsord Tower and the doors slid open, revealing the entrance to the revolving restaurant. Alphonso continued to talk.

entries.title: Ewald Alphonso (R): ""Gasom became a symbol of our natio..."
entries.dialogueText: "Gasom became a symbol of our national resurgence. I remember navigating through the maze of old monarchist sentiments and the ambitions of Soll and his new republic..."

entries.dialogueText: Alphonso took a sip from his whiskey and looked out into the distance.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I'm sure Soll's National Autarky P..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm sure Soll's National Autarky Plan posed difficulties for you as a businessman."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso (R)
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso (R): ""Not to be immodest, but yes. Under..."
entries.dialogueText: "Not to be immodest, but yes. Under my leadership, Gasom transitioned from a state-controlled entity to a key player in the global energy market."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso (R)
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso (R): ""Ah, yes. That particular movement..."
entries.dialogueText: "Ah, yes. That particular movement was a significant counterforce during Sordland's transition to democracy. It gave us an idea of the deep-seated monarchist loyalties some Sords still had."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso (R)
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso (R): ""Simply put, it was a time of rebui..."
entries.dialogueText: "Simply put, it was a time of rebuilding and reimagining Sordland's future."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso (R)
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso (R): ""It wasn't all bad. You'll recall m..."
entries.dialogueText: "It wasn't all bad. You'll recall my predecessor's original intent with the NAP was to make Sordland self-sufficient and independent from foreign influences."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso (R)
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso (R): ""Let's not bore our delegation furt..."
entries.dialogueText: "Let's not bore our delegation further. We all know why you're really here."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso (R)
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso (R): ""Today the corporation stands as a..."
entries.dialogueText: "Today the corporation stands as a symbol of our success in attracting foreign investment and technological advancement. Proving Sordland's resilience and adaptability in a changing world economy."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso (R)
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso (R): ""Ultimately, their defeat helped so..."
entries.dialogueText: "Ultimately, their defeat helped solidify the republic's foundation, but it also left lingering questions about national unity and the role of traditionalist forces in modern Sordland."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso (R)
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso (R): ""Soll's government made massive eff..."
entries.dialogueText: "Soll's government made massive efforts to repair the war's physical and social damage, creating a new civic identity grounded in republican values."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso (R)
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso (R): ""While it succeeded in some respect..."
entries.dialogueText: "While it succeeded in some respects, like infrastructure development, it also isolated us economically."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""What about your own history with H..."
entries.dialogueText: "What about your own history with Holsord, Mr. President?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic

entries.dialogueText: I raised my glass. The others followed suit.

entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Thank you for the hospitality and..."
entries.dialogueText: "Thank you for the hospitality and kindness you've shown us thus far. I'm eager to hear your proposal."

Ewald Alphonso (R)
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso (R): ""So. What we're offering Rizia is t..."
entries.dialogueText: "So. What we're offering Rizia is the chance to purchase Sordish government bonds with a four-year maturity at excellent rates."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "There was a pause in the discussion..."
entries.dialogueText: There was a pause in the discussion as the first course was served. It was a deconstructed version of Lachaven-style lorscha, with a hot seafood stock poured over clams, mussels and cubed raw salmon.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "After we'd been eating for a few mi..."
entries.dialogueText: After we'd been eating for a few minutes, President Alphonso cleared his throat.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Given the current recession in Sor..."
entries.dialogueText: "Given the current recession in Sordland, how can you assure us that these investments will bear fruit?"

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso (R)
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso (R): ""Despite the current recession, we'..."
entries.dialogueText: "Despite the current recession, we're on a path to economic revitalization, thanks to significant investments being secured from Qinal and Anraka as well as our progressive policy reforms."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso (R)
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso (R): ""This bond issue is a chance for Ri..."
entries.dialogueText: "This bond issue is a chance for Rizia not only to make financial gains, but also to diversify its economy."

entries.title: Ewald Alphonso (R): ""This bond issue is a chance for Ri..."
entries.dialogueText: "This bond issue is a chance for Rizia not only to make financial gains, but to strengthen its resource-based economy through energy investments into Sordland. We will offer discounts if we see eye to eye on this deal."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso (R)
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso (R): ""I understand that. But with great..."
entries.dialogueText: "I understand that. But with great risk comes great reward."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""We need to review the economic per..."
entries.dialogueText: "We need to review the economic performance indicators and further recovery plans thoroughly. Growth forecasts alone aren't enough."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""And risky. As we've seen from time..."
entries.dialogueText: "And risky. As we've seen from time to time with our own Rizian Royal Gold company, privatization has its drawbacks."

entries.speaker: Gus Manger (R)
entries.title: Gus Manger (R): ""A valid question. But our economic..."
entries.dialogueText: "A valid question. But our economic policies are designed to withstand political changes."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso (R)
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso (R): ""As I mentioned, the investments we..."
entries.dialogueText: "As I mentioned, the investments we're received from Qinal and Anraka are substantial. Coupled with our reforms, they're projected to significantly boost our economy."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso (R)
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso (R): ""This is not mere speculation. Our..."
entries.dialogueText: "This is not mere speculation. Our plans are calculated based on economic principles behind a sound free-market strategy."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Your re-election is far from guara..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your re-election is far from guaranteed, President Alphonso. How can we be sure your successor will follow the economic course you've set?"

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso (R)
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso (R): ""The landscape in Sordland is ever-..."
entries.dialogueText: "The landscape in Sordland is ever-changing, and Anton Rayne could well prevail in the next elections. Despite this, the bond proposal is built with long-term stability and growth in mind."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You mentioned future benefits for..."
entries.dialogueText: "You mentioned future benefits for Rizia by signing this deal. Could you elaborate on what these might entail?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Aren't you concerned about how thi..."
entries.dialogueText: "Aren't you concerned about how this might affect Sordland's domestic market?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Can you be any more specific about..."
entries.dialogueText: "Can you be any more specific about how our economy will benefit?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Sounds promising, but I'm concerne..."
entries.dialogueText: "Sounds promising, but I'm concerned about your elections. How can we be sure this isn't just a fleeting partnership?"

entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Your liberal economic policies, yo..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your liberal economic policies, your plan to sell shares of Gasom... it's all very ambitious."

entries.title: Gus Manger (R): ""I'd like to move on to the financi..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'd like to move on to the financial specifics of our government bonds, focusing on the returns in Rizian Guilders."

entries.speaker: Gus Manger (R)
entries.title: Gus Manger (R): ""Based on your current treasury sta..."
entries.dialogueText: "Based on your current treasury status, I'd suggest you go with our bigger, better proposal. Invest 12 billion Rizian guilders now, and your returns will be through the roof."

entries.speaker: Gus Manger (R)
entries.title: Gus Manger (R): ""Now, considering a more cautious i..."
entries.dialogueText: "Now, considering a more cautious investment of 3 billion Rizian Guilders, the potential returns in the case of a successful economic recovery are still impressive."

entries.speaker: Gus Manger (R)
entries.title: Gus Manger (R): ""If our projections are accurate, R..."
entries.dialogueText: "If our projections are accurate, Rizia could see its investment grow to about 9 billion guilders. Not as much as if you'd invested more, but nothing to sneeze at either."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso (R)
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso (R): ""Foreshadowing Sordland's broader e..."
entries.dialogueText: "Foreshadowing Sordland's broader economic pivot towards market liberalization, I may add."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso (R)
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso (R): ""Some of those traditionalist force..."
entries.dialogueText: "Some of those traditionalist forces evolved into the National Front Party, while others formed the conservative wing of the USP itself."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso (R)
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso (R): ""In Holsord, this meant not only ov..."
entries.dialogueText: "In Holsord, this meant not only overhauling the city's infrastructure, but also its very culture. But by the '40s, many of the programs had become unnecessary."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso (R)
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso (R): ""In the end, the result was a const..."
entries.dialogueText: "In the end, the result was a constrained economy, lacking in innovation and global competitiveness. That's why we stagnated in the '40s."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""In light of our recent internation..."
entries.dialogueText: "In light of our recent international tribulations, we in Rizia are eager to pursue new partnerships."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso (R)
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso (R): ""Merkopan geopolitics can be very t..."
entries.dialogueText: "Merkopan geopolitics can be very treacherous. Rest assured that in Sordland, you can find a safe and trusted source for the future."

entries.speaker: Gus Manger (R)
entries.title: Gus Manger (R): ""I do know that your treasury has s..."
entries.dialogueText: "I do know that your treasury has seen a reduction in income lately. We are looking for investments for this deal and hope you can afford such endeavors."

entries.speaker: Gus Manger (R)
entries.title: Gus Manger (R): ""I do know that your treasury has b..."
entries.dialogueText: "I do know that your treasury has been seeing a significant influx of funds lately."

entries.speaker: Gus Manger (R)
entries.title: Gus Manger (R): ""Assuming you are able to invest in..."
entries.dialogueText: "Assuming you are able to invest into Sordland, we can promise you very lucrative returns."

entries.speaker: Gus Manger (R)
entries.title: Gus Manger (R): ""Money that sits around is money wa..."
entries.dialogueText: "Money that sits around is money wasted. Nobody wants that, not even the Golden Kingdom."

entries.speaker: Gus Manger (R)
entries.title: Gus Manger (R): ""Additionally, Rizian energy output..."
entries.dialogueText: "Additionally, Rizian energy output seems to be historically low at the moment."

entries.speaker: Gus Manger (R)
entries.title: Gus Manger (R): ""It's great to see strong energy pr..."
entries.dialogueText: "It's great to see strong energy production in Rizia. We could arrange future purchases of energy from your kingdom if our relations develop."

entries.speaker: Gus Manger (R)
entries.title: Gus Manger (R): ""We can't do much about that right..."
entries.dialogueText: "We can't do much about that right now, but perhaps today can be a stepping stone towards a lucrative agreement in that direction."

entries.speaker: Gus Manger (R)
entries.title: Gus Manger (R): ""Sordish industries are seeing dema..."
entries.dialogueText: "Sordish industries are seeing demand that not even our own Gasom can meet."

entries.speaker: Gus Manger (R)
entries.title: Gus Manger (R): ""We're talking about a budget incre..."
entries.dialogueText: "We're talking about a budget increase of upwards of 36 billion guilders over the bond's term. You'd be tripling your money."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "As the restaurant continued its gen..."
entries.dialogueText: As the restaurant continued its gentle orbit, our second course arrived. It consisted of an airy sheep-cheese mousse between two sheets of crisp pastry, garnished with a rainbow of fresh herbs and edible flowers.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Gus took a quick sip from his glass..."
entries.dialogueText: Gus took a quick sip from his glass of Sordish wine.

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""A larger bond investment does seem..."
entries.dialogueText: "A larger bond investment does seem like a good way to leverage the momentum we've built."

entries.speaker: Gus Manger (R)

entries.dialogueText: "The question now is, where does Rizia see itself in the future? As a regional power in South Merkopa, or are you aiming for a more global presence?"

entries.dialogueText: "Here is what I believe. In my years of diplomatic service, I've seen Rizia's influence grow. We do have the capability and resources to be more than just a regional power."

entries.dialogueText: "Well said, Your Highness. Yet as a seasoned diplomat, I must emphasize prudence."

entries.dialogueText: "Your caution is prudent, Ms. Werner, but I believe in the dynamism of capitalism. It thrives on bold moves and calculated risks."

entries.dialogueText: "Our bond proposal is a stepping stone towards that future, where Rizia is not at the corner of global politics, but a leading voice."

entries.title: Ewald Alphonso (R): ""That perspective aligns with my vi..."

entries.dialogueText: "Valid thoughts, Mr. Esquibel. But progressive capitalism is all about seizing opportunities and being at the forefront of economic innovation."

entries.title: Player_Romus: ""That's an ambitious forecast, Mr...."
entries.dialogueText: "That's an ambitious forecast, Mr. Manger."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""These numbers are impressive, but..."
entries.dialogueText: "These numbers are impressive, but they hinge on a lot of 'ifs' and 'maybes.' I need more than optimistic projections to justify such a large investment."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""This could be a game-changer for R..."
entries.dialogueText: "This could be a game-changer for Rizia's budget."

entries.dialogueText: "Think about it, Your Majesty. If your grandmother Queen Lyza had exerted similar caution, neither of our countries would be where they are today."

entries.title: Ewald Alphonso (R): ""Oh, yes. By embracing the principl..."
entries.dialogueText: "Oh, yes. By embracing the principles of free-market capitalism, we can unlock new heights of prosperity."

entries.title: Ewald Alphonso (R): ""Think of our shared history, and h..."
entries.dialogueText: "Think of our shared history, and how trade prospered under Queen Lyza. It's proof of how calculated risks can lead to enduring economic booms."

entries.dialogueText: "What do you say to this new opportunity, King Romus?"
